Rooms.Name: The Plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on the plains, to the north you notice a small path into the hills.
And to the east the plains continue. A sign is on a pole here.

Exits.Description: The plains continue here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign points North, East and south.
To the south it reads "City of Midgaard"
To the North it reads "Moria Mountains"
To the east it reads "Gnome Village"
                    "Dwarf Village"
                    "Elven Forest of Namir"

Rooms.Name: The Lane
Rooms.Description:
You are strolling along a pleasant, shady lane. The road is lined on both
sides by tall, stately trees which lend the scene with a sense of quiet
serenity. You can follow the road north or south.

Rooms.Name: The Turning Point
Rooms.Description:
The trees stand close here, and the tall, bushy undergrowth prevents you
from seeing far in any direction save north, where a broad lane leads off into
the distance; and west, where the same lane continues towards what looks like a
fairly large city. The muted sounds of city commotion reach your ears from a
distance; stray dogs barking, children crying, and street salesmen shouting.
A large sign stands on the right side of the road.

Exits.Description: You see a path and a large castle in the distance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign points to the North, East and to the West.

To the west it reads "City of Midgaard"
To the east it reads "King Welmars Castle"
To the north is reads "Moria Mountains"
                      "Dwarf village"
                      "Gnome village"
                      "Elven Forest of Namir"

Rooms.Name: City Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You stand on the outskirts of a large city - Midgaard; the capital of this
land. The road leads east into the peace and quiet - and dangers - of the
forest; and to the west it becomes the main street of the town; surrounded by a
confusion of shops, bars, and market places.  A large iron gate stands to 
the south.  You can hear strange sounds coming from the other side.

Rooms.Name: The Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small, rickety bridge over a small mountain river.
To the south lies the forest Miden'nir. The way north seems to be blocked
by lots of fallen rocks.

Exits.Description: If you go south, you will enter the Miden'Nir.

Rooms.Name: The Trail to Miden'Nir
Rooms.Description:
You are in a light forest. A path leads south, but the passage to the east
is easy enough. To the west, smoke can be seen rising above the treetops. The
sound of a river can be heard north of here.

Exits.Description: To the north, you see a small bridge.
More light forest.
This path cuts through the darkness of the Miden'Nir.

Rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark forest. To the east, mountains block passage. From here,
only the lighter forest to the west or south offer a way to travel.

Exits.Description: The forest is darker to the south.
The forest gets lighter as you go west.

Rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
Rooms.Description:
The forest is deep here and the wind blows through the trees and through
your hair. To the north, the forest gets lighter. However, the southern and
eastern paths place you even deeper in the wood.

Exits.Description: The forest is lighter in this direction.
More and darker woods.
There is a small path leading west.

Rooms.Name: On a Small Path
Rooms.Description:
A path is here, leading east and south. Mountains slash the scenery to the
west of here.

Exits.Description: Wind-swept forest.
To the south, the trail continues.

Rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
Rooms.Description:
More trees... You can go north, south or travel toward the Moria mountains 
that lie east of here.

Exits.Description: The trees lighten up a bit this way.
Huge gray mountains lie in this direction.
The forest continues.

Rooms.Name: The Crossroads
Rooms.Description:
Here foot worn paths lead north, south and east. The trees seem to be closing
in on you at this point.

Exits.Description: Trees as far as the eye can see.
There is an especially dark part of the forest this way.
There is an especially dark section of forest this way.

Rooms.Name: The Trail
Rooms.Description:
You are on a north-south trail. To the west, impassable mountains glare at
you.

Exits.Description: The trail bends to the north.
To the south, the path re-enters the forest.

Rooms.Name: At the Foot of the Moria Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You can go west or south and re-enter the forest. The Moria mountains 
prevent passage in any other direction.

Exits.Description: A light section of forest.
The forest continues here.

Rooms.Name: The Miden'Nir
Rooms.Description:
The forest is light here and gets lighter to the north. To the west
everything gets dark. The wind kicks up as you ponder your options.

Exits.Description: There is a small clearing to the north.
It gets darker and thicker this way.

Rooms.Name: Deep Forest
Rooms.Description:
It is quite dark here, forest surrounds you. Footsteps can be heard, but
their direction can not be determined. A path lead to the turning point to the
south.

Exits.Description: More forest.
Lighter forest and mountains in the distance.
The forest continues.

Rooms.Name: Light Forest
Rooms.Description:
The forest is light here and you can easily pick your way through the trail.
To the east, the forest becomes deep again. South, the trail continues.

Exits.Description: A trail leading north-south.
The trees get thicker as you go east.
More trees and some small hills.

Rooms.Name: The Sink
Rooms.Description:
The ground is quite muddy here and puddles are all around. Your boots make a
disgusting SQUISH as you walk here. You can go in any of the four cardinal
directions from here. Hopefully, it will be dryer. The path to the turning
point can be seen to the east.

Exits.Description: The Miden'Nir continues.
The trees get VERY thick to the south. You can barely see...
Some light trees and daylight.

Rooms.Name: Near the Moria Mountains
Rooms.Description:
The most prominent feature here is the Moria mountains that lie to the east.
To the south a small path leads back to the turning point, to the north you can 
enter a forest and to the west lies a sink.

Exits.Description: Many trees to the north.
There is a bit of a slope downward to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Fading Trail
Rooms.Description:
The trail becomes nearly impassable here. You can go south and west, as the
forest is relatively light. To the north, you can see a path.

Exits.Description: You can see a trail this way.
Dark forests.
Light trees and mountains in the distance.

Rooms.Name: The Dark Path
Rooms.Description:
You are hemmed in by trees on either side of you. There is no way to go east
or west. The wind, which howled earlier, seems to have died in this natural
tunnel.

Exits.Description: Ahhh... daylight.
More darkness.

Rooms.Name: On the Verge of Darkness
Rooms.Description:
The forest is getting pretty thick here. To the south, the forest is too
dense to venture into. The eastern path seems the only way to go from here.

Exits.Description: Light and a visible trail.

Rooms.Name: Carnage
Rooms.Description:
Here, you see a gruesome sight. Blood is everywhere... on the trees and
soaked into the ground. Two carcasses lie in front of you, seeming to look up
at you. The forest is impassable to the south, but the path continues north and
west. There is a small dark track to the east.

Exits.Description: Darkness...
More dark forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The corpses looked as if they have been pierced by a large, jagged
spear.  The damage these people sustained is simply amazing.  Worse, the
lips on the bodies are a light shade of blue, hinting at poison in
their systems.

Rooms.Name: Stench
Rooms.Description:
There is a sickening stench here. It smells of blood and death. To the
north, you catch glimpses of daylight. To the east, you simply cannot see. The
trees are close and stifling.

Exits.Description: Daylight and a trail to follow.
Darkness.. the smell seems to come from here.

Rooms.Name: Small Path
Rooms.Description:
You walk on a small path that makes its way towards a small forest just at 
the base of the moria mountains.

Rooms.Name: Small Path
Rooms.Description:
You walk on a small path that makes its way towards a small forest just at 
the base of the moria mountains.
